plan.focus_en: 了 for things that already happened, and asking where and when (哪儿, 几点).

items.title_en: Read and read aloud: 去北京旅游
Guided mission: taking a taxi to the airport

translations: I really like watching anime. In the evening I watch it on my phone in my room.
My favourite is One Piece. It's a Japanese anime, and it's really fun.
But I can't understand Japanese. So I'm learning Japanese.
In the future I want to travel to Japan. I want to go to Tokyo and have fun!
Last month my older sister and I went on a trip to Beijing.
We went by plane. The plane was fast, but the tickets were expensive.
Beijing is big, and it was hot too. We walked a lot and were very tired.
In the evening we went to a restaurant to eat roast duck. The roast duck was delicious!
I think Beijing is really interesting. I want to go again one day!

missions.title: Taking a taxi to the airport
missions.goal: Say where you're going and when your flight is, ask the driver to hurry, then pay.

steps.prompt_en: Say you're going to the airport.

steps.partner_en: OK. What time is your flight?
steps.prompt_en: Say your flight is at 3 pm.

steps.partner_zh: 现在路上车很多，要一个小时。
steps.partner_en: There's a lot of traffic now. It'll take an hour.
steps.prompt_en: Ask the driver to go a bit faster.
answers_en: Could you go a bit faster?
Can you go a little faster?

steps.prompt_en: Say thanks and that you'll pay with your phone.
answers_en: Thanks, I'll pay with my phone.

missions.title: Checking in at a hotel
missions.goal: Check in, confirm how many nights, and ask about breakfast and the lift.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，欢迎光临！请问有预订吗？
steps.partner_en: Hello, welcome! Do you have a booking?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, you booked a room.

steps.partner_zh: 请给我看一下您的护照。
steps.partner_en: Please let me see your passport.

steps.partner_zh: 这是您的房卡。房间在八楼。
steps.partner_en: Here's your key card. Your room is on the 8th floor.
answers_en: Excuse me, what time is breakfast?

steps.partner_zh: 早饭七点到十点，在二楼。
steps.partner_en: Breakfast is from 7 to 10, on the 2nd floor.
answers_en: Excuse me, where is the lift?

missions.closing_zh: 电梯在左边。祝您住得愉快！
missions.closing_en: The lift is on the left. Enjoy your stay!
